kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: The role of climate change in the Nepal floods
wire.summary: The deadly flash floods in Nepal are not a surprise to many scientists. Glacial melt is accelerating because of climate change, putting millions of people at risk.

wire.title: Helicopter pilot describes what he's seen rescuing people in Nepal
wire.summary: Andy Thapa is a charter and rescue pilot for a Nepali helicopter company. He's been rescuing people stranded by the catastrophic flooding, and carrying them to safety.

wire.title: Trump directs federal government to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America
wire.summary: President Trump signed an executive order on Thursday directing the federal government to rename Lake Ontario amid an escalating trade dispute with Canada .

wire.title: The stakes are high as Kevin Warsh is set to give his first major speech as Fed Chair
wire.summary: The stakes are high as Fed Chair Kevin Warsh prepares to give a speech on Friday at the annual gathering of economists and central bankers in Jackson Hole, Wyoming.

wire.title: Ratko Mladic, ex-Bosnian Serb warlord who oversaw atrocities, has died at 84
wire.summary: Ratko Mladic was one of the most notorious figures of a war that killed over 100,000 people in the 1990s. He commanded his troops to "scorch the brains" of the Bosnian Muslims and boasted of being a "Serbian God."

wire.title: The real cause of most wildfires? People
wire.summary: More than three quarters of all wildfires in the U.S. are caused by human behavior including accidents, negligence and arson.

wire.title: Meta reaches $17B settlement. And, nuclear regulator to abandon radiation safety rule
wire.summary: Meta and the states that sued the company have agreed to a $17 billion settlement. And, nuclear regulators are preparing to abandon a decades-old radiation safety rule.

wire.title: Rwandans love their milk bars. The health minister wishes they'd drink a little less
wire.summary: A big glass of moo juice — no, make that several glasses a day — is common in Rwanda. Is that too much of a good thing?

wire.title: Floods kill nearly 400 people in Nepal and Tibet, with 90 Americans among the missing
wire.summary: Many of the missing are foreign tourists after deadly floods hit the Nepal-Tibet border, sweeping away entire villages.

wire.title: School districts face a back-to-school math problem: The high price of diesel
wire.summary: With the war in Iran driving up fuel prices, diesel is now nearly $5.60 a gallon, affecting school districts at the start of the year.

wire.title: Collapsed glacier likely caused devastating Nepal-Tibet floods, scientists say
wire.summary: Preliminary investigations by scientists have pointed to a collapsed glacier as the cause, highlighting the issue of rapidly melting Himalayan ice.

wire.title: What we know about deadly Nepal-Tibet floods
wire.summary: Hundreds have died or are missing in Wednesday's flooding and landslides on the border of Nepal and Tibet.

wire.title: Convicted Bosnian Serb war criminal Mladić dies aged 84
wire.summary: He was jailed for life in 2017 for genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity during the wars in the ex-Yugoslavia in 1992-95.

wire.title: Jury deliberating in trial of Lindsay Clancy, US woman accused of killing her children
wire.summary: Prosecutors argued Clancy made a calculated decision to murder the children, while the defence argued that she was suffering from postpartum psychosis.

wire.title: Norwegians lay flowers at palace as King Harald's condition worsens
wire.summary: The 89-year-old's condition is described as "extremely serious" and members of his family have visited him in hospital.

wire.title: Board of Peace's Gaza envoy criticises Israeli strikes and Hamas actions
wire.summary: Nickolay Mladenov warns that a collapse of last October's ceasefire would be "a point of no return" for the region.
